distortion.name: D4c_p_up

phase_e_spec.description: f^N, N = stored truth hadrons with |pdg| = 2212 among the <= 12 highest-energy (part_gen truncation)

distortion.normalization: unit mean over the pseudodata's truth-passing rows

reco_coverage.criterion: every pass_reco row must have a built input. Rows without reco have no reconstructed object to build a token from and are zeroed for BOTH arms, exactly as the production loader zeroes ours
